blocks.content:
The Chief Minister is the real executive authority in the State.

Appointment:
• Appointed by the Governor
• Leader of majority party in Legislative Assembly

Tenure:
• Holds office during the pleasure of the Governor
The Chief Minister is the real executive authority in the State.

items: Always remember that the Chief Minister is appointed by the Governor, selecting the leader of the majority party in the Legislative Assembly.
Tenure Question Alert: The Chief Minister holds office during the pleasure of the Governor.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Chief Minister acts as the real executive authority within the State administration.
Appointment of the Chief Minister is made directly by the Governor.
The individual appointed is typically the leader of the majority party in the Legislative Assembly.
The Chief Minister does not have a fixed term specified here, but holds office during the pleasure of the Governor.
